description: In a large open boat workshop with a corrugated roof, the shiny, silvery metal hull of a new boat hangs from ropes above a rusty steel cradle and slowly turns as it is lowered. Workers in hard hats and yellow or orange high-visibility clothes hold the ropes and guide it from below. Coils of silver wire stand in the foreground, a forklift waits behind, and the sea and a quay are visible through the wide open doors.
